search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Stopped after focused searches and source review; the available evidence did not resolve whether Largan completed an investment in TSC.
The claim does not specify a date for the 30% ownership figure; the 30.93% figure is historical, while the official Q1 2026 report gives 28.5%.
The Q1 2026 ownership disclosure found does not establish SAS's current rank among TSC shareholders.
The Largan evidence located reports intent to invest, not completion. This leaves the completed-investment atom unresolved rather than disproven.
